subject: Investigate memory leak in payments service

thread.body: Memory leak detected in payments-svc. Heap growing from 512MB to 2GB over 6 hours. Probable cause: connection pool not being released after failed transactions.
Confirmed: pg-pool v3.6.1 has a known issue where connections held during transaction rollback are not returned. Upgrading to v3.7.0 should fix it.
Automated health check: memory stabilised at 540MB after rolling restart. Monitoring alert cleared.
